plugin.name: Alignment_Values
plugin.author: Zargulis
plugin.purpose: Show alignment values when using aura sight or seek

muclient.triggers: <trigger name="alignment" enabled="y" match="^(?Alignment : )?(?.*) is (?(a Lord of Ruin|an Avatar of Darkness|a Harbinger of Doom|an Emissary of Evil|nefarious|wicked|diabolical|heartless|heinous|foul|cruel|corrupt|mean|unpleasant|grey|neutral|kind|pure|good|righteous|virtuous|reverent|beneficent|angelic|saintly|seraphic|an Emissary of Good|a Harbinger of Hope|an Avatar of Light|a Lord of Angels))\.$" regexp="y" omit_from_output="y" sequence="100" script="alignment_capture" />
muclient.script:
require 'aardwolf_colors'
aligns = { ["a Lord of Ruin"] = "a @RLord of Ruin (-2500)", ["an Avatar of Darkness"] = "an @RAvatar of Darkness (-2499 to -2200)", ["a Harbinger of Doom"] = "a @RHarbinger of Doom (-2199 to -1900)", ["an Emissary of Evil"] = "an @REmissary of Evil (-1899 to -1600)", ["nefarious"] = "@RNefarious (-1599 to -1400)", ["wicked"] = "@RWicked (-1399 to -1200)", ["diabolical"] = "@RDiabolical (-1199 to -900)", ["heartless"] = "@RHeartless (-899 to -700)", ["heinous"] = "@x214Heinous (-699 to -500)", ["foul"] = "@x214Foul (-499 to -400)", ["cruel"] = "@x214Cruel (-399 to -300)", ["corrupt"] = "@x214Corrupt (-299 to -200)", ["mean"] = "@x214Mean (-199 to -100)", ["unpleasant"] = "@x214Unpleasant (-99 to -50)",
["grey"] = "@wGrey (0 to 0)", ["neutral"] = "@wNeutral (-49 < 0 < 50)",
["kind"] = "@YKind (51 to 100)", ["pure"] = "@YPure (101 to 200)", ["good"] = "@YGood (201 to 300)", ["righteous"] = "@YRighteous (301 to 400)", ["virtuous"] = "@YVirtuous (401 to 500)", ["reverent"] = "@YReverent (501 to 700)", ["beneficent"] = "@GBeneficent (701 to 900)", ["angelic"] = "@GAngelic (901 to 1200)", ["saintly"] = "@GSaintly (1201 to 1400)", ["seraphic"] = "@GSeraphic (1401 to 1600)", ["an Emissary of Good"] = "an @GEmissary of Good (1601 to 1900)", ["a Harbinger of Hope"] = "a @GHarbinger of Hope (1901 to 2200)", ["an Avatar of Light"] = "an @GAvatar of Light (2201 to 2499)", ["a Lord of Angels"] = "a @GLord of Angels (2500)" }
function alignment_capture(name, line, args) local note = "@w" if args.seek then note = "@G" .. args.seek .. "@w" end note = note .. args.mob .. " is " .. aligns[args.align] AnsiNote(ColoursToANSI(note)) end
